entry.title: New: HLU-28 Bills 173-176 (2026) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
BILL 173 (2026), BILL 174 (2026), BILL 175 (2026), AND BILL 176 (2026), COMMUNITY PLAN AMENDMENTS AND CHANGES IN ZONING FROM THE A-1 AND A-2 APARTMENT DISTRICTS TO THE H-3 AND H-4 HOTEL DISTRICTS FOR CERTAIN SOUTH MAUI AND WEST MAUI PROPERTIES, INCLUDING PROPERTIES OPERATING LIKE HOTELS (HLU-28)
